<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light"><head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Advanced Statistical Arbitrage with RL — From Price Spreads to Vega Pairs</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --surface-1:      #fcfcfb;
    --surface-2:      #f3f2ee;
    --page-plane:     #f9f9f7;
    --text-primary:   #0b0b0b;
    --text-secondary: #52514e;
    --text-muted:     #898781;
    --gridline:       #e1e0d9;
    --baseline:       #c3c2b7;
    --border:         rgba(11,11,11,0.10);

    --series-1: #2a78d6; /* blue    - proposed / RL / our method (hero) */
    --series-2: #eb6834; /* orange  - simplest baseline (DM / NN)      */
    --series-7: #4a3aa7; /* violet  - secondary baseline (OU / orig)   */
    --series-8: #e34948; /* red     - negative / caution               */
    --good:     #006300;
    --critical: #d03b3b;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    background: var(--page-plane);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  }
  body { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  .deck {
    width: 100%;
    scroll-snap-type: y proximity;
  }

  .slide {
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 64px 88px 56px;
    background: var(--surface-1);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gridline);
    position: relative;
  }
  .slide:nth-of-type(even) { background: var(--surface-1); }

  .slide .kicker {
    font-size: 15px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--series-1);
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .slide h1 {
    font-size: 38px;
    margin: 0 0 6px 0;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }
  .slide h2 {
    font-size: 20px;
    margin: 0 0 26px 0;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .slide .body {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 18px;
    min-height: 0;
  }

  ul.points { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 13px; }
  ul.points li {
    font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-primary);
    padding-left: 26px; position: relative;
  }
  ul.points li::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 9px;
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--series-1);
  }
  ul.points li b { color: var(--series-1); font-weight: 700; }
  ul.points li .tag { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 15px; }

  .two-col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 44px; align-items: start; }
  .three-col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 26px; align-items: stretch; }

  .card {
    background: var(--surface-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px 22px;
  }
  .card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 12px 0; font-size: 16px; color: var(--series-1);
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-weight: 700;
  }
  .card.baseline h3 { color: var(--series-2); }
  .card.secondary h3 { color: var(--series-7); }
  .card p, .card li { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .card ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; }
  .card ul li { margin-bottom: 8px; }

  table.data {
    width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 16px;
  }
  table.data th {
    text-align: right; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-muted);
    padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--baseline);
    font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  table.data th:first-child, table.data td:first-child { text-align: left; }
  table.data td {
    text-align: right; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gridline);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-primary);
  }
  table.data tr.hero td { color: var(--series-1); font-weight: 700; }
  table.data tr.total td { border-top: 2px solid var(--baseline); font-weight: 700; }
  td.neg { color: var(--series-8); }
  td.pos { color: var(--good); }
  table.data.small { font-size: 14px; }
  table.data.small th, table.data.small td { padding: 6px 10px; }

  .barchart { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
  .bar-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr 70px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .bar-row .label { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); text-align: right; }
  .bar-track { background: var(--gridline); border-radius: 4px; height: 20px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; }
  .bar-row .value { font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-primary); }
  .legend-row { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .legend-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .legend-swatch { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; }

  .mapping-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 15.5px; }
  .mapping-table th { text-align: left; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 6px 14px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--baseline); }
  .mapping-table td { padding: 11px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gridline); vertical-align: top; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.4; }
  .mapping-table td.dim { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }
  .mapping-table td.paper { color: var(--series-7); }
  .mapping-table td.ours { color: var(--series-1); }

  .flow { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 0; }
  .flow-step { flex: 1; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; position: relative; }
  .flow-step + .flow-step { margin-left: 34px; }
  .flow-step + .flow-step::before {
    content: "\2192"; position: absolute; left: -30px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
    font-size: 22px; color: var(--text-muted);
  }
  .flow-step .num { font-size: 13px; color: var(--series-1); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .flow-step h4 { margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 18px; }
  .flow-step p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; }

  .eq {
    background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 24px; font-size: 19px; text-align: center; color: var(--series-1);
    font-family: "Cambria Math", Georgia, serif;
  }
  .eq .caption { display: block; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 8px; }
  .eq-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  .eq-small { font-size: 16px; }

  .stat-row { display: flex; gap: 22px; }
  .stat-tile { flex: 1; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; text-align: center; }
  .stat-tile .num { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--series-1); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .stat-tile .lbl { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 6px; }

  .footnote { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 12px; }

  .progress { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--series-1); transition: width .1s linear; z-index: 20; }
  .pageno { position: absolute; bottom: 18px; right: 28px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; z-index: 20; background: rgba(252,252,251,0.85); padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); }

  .title-slide { justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; }
  .title-slide h1 { font-size: 48px; max-width: 900px; }
  .title-slide h2 { font-size: 22px; max-width: 780px; }
  .title-slide .authors { margin-top: 36px; font-size: 16px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .title-slide .authors b { color: var(--text-primary); }
  .title-slide .source { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); }
  .title-slide .scrollhint { margin-top: 60px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); }

  .center-slide { justify-content: center; align-items: center; text-align: center; }
  .center-slide h1 { font-size: 42px; }

  svg text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }
  .diagram-wrap { background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px 24px; }
  .diagram-wrap .cap { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 6px; text-align: center; }

  .chip-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .chip { width: 62px; height: 62px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }
  .chip .sym { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; }
  .chip .val { font-size: 12px; margin-top: 3px; opacity: 0.9; }
  .chip-arrow { font-size: 22px; color: var(--text-muted); }
  .chip-box { border: 2px solid var(--series-1); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--series-1); font-weight: 700; }
</style>
<style>
      @page {size:13.333333in 7.5in;margin:0}
      html,body,.deck {width:1280px;margin:0;padding:0}
      .slide {width:1280px;height:720px;min-height:0;padding:40px 64px 40px;
              box-sizing:border-box;break-inside:avoid;page-break-after:always;break-after:page}
      .slide:last-child {page-break-after:auto;break-after:auto}
      .slide h1 {font-size:34px}.slide h2 {font-size:18px;margin-bottom:18px}
      .slide .body {gap:14px}.slide .two-col {gap:30px}
      .slide img {max-height:410px;object-fit:contain}
      .title-slide h1 {font-size:46px}.title-slide h2 {font-size:22px}
      .progress,.scrollhint {display:none}.pageno {bottom:10px}
      @media print {.pageno {display:none}}
    </style>
</head>
<body data-layout-overflow="[]">
<div class="deck" id="deck">

  <!-- 1 -->
  <section class="slide title-slide">
    <div class="kicker">Deep Learning in Finance · Course Project</div>
    <h1>Advanced Statistical Arbitrage with Reinforcement Learning</h1>
    <h2>From discretized price-spread trading to sizing vega-neutral IV-spread pairs</h2>
    <div class="authors">Based on <b>Ning &amp; Lee (2024)</b>, <i>Advanced Statistical Arbitrage with Reinforcement Learning</i>, arXiv:2403.12180 — extended to our own ATM vega pairs project.</div>
    <div class="source">rl-atm-vega-pairs</div>
    <div class="scrollhint">Scroll down ↓</div>
  </section>

  <!-- P1: paper in one slide -->
  <section class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">The Paper</div>
    <h1>Ning &amp; Lee (2024): swap two hand-tuned pieces for two learned ones</h1>
    <h2>Pairs trading has two phases — the paper replaces the traditional tool in each</h2>
    <div class="body">
      <table class="mapping-table">
        <tbody><tr><th>Phase</th><th>Traditional approach</th><th>This paper</th></tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="dim">Part 1 · Which spread to trade</td>
          <td class="paper">Hand-fit B (Distance Method or OU)</td>
          <td class="ours">EMRT — B chosen to minimize empirical reversion time</td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="dim">Part 2 · When to trade it</td>
          <td class="paper">Fixed threshold rule (e.g. trade at ±1σ)</td>
          <td class="ours">Q-learning — a policy learned from experience</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody></table>
      <div class="stat-row" style="margin-top:8px;">
        <div class="stat-tile">
          <div class="num">10 pairs</div>
          <div class="lbl">US sector pairs, formed 2022, traded 2023</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-tile">
          <div class="num">2 benchmarks</div>
          <div class="lbl">Distance Method &amp; OU trading</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-tile">
          <div class="num">Daily Sharpe</div>
          <div class="lbl">headline metric, next slides</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pageno" data-n="">2 / 7</div>
  </section>

  <!-- P2/P3: spread + EMRT -->
  <section class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Part 1 · Formation</div>
    <h1>EMRT: average time from a big swing back to the mean</h1>
    <h2>Find the meaningful peaks and troughs, time each one back to the mean line, average the times</h2>
    <div class="body">
      <div class="eq">
        X<sub>t</sub> = S<sub>1,t</sub> − B·S<sub>2,t</sub>
        <span class="caption">The spread. Each B gives a different spread; some revert quickly, some drift.</span>
      </div>
      <div class="diagram-wrap">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 760 210" width="100%" height="210">
          <rect x="110" y="8" width="90" height="194" fill="var(--series-1)" opacity="0.08"></rect>
          <rect x="290" y="8" width="90" height="194" fill="var(--series-1)" opacity="0.08"></rect>
          <rect x="470" y="8" width="90" height="194" fill="var(--series-1)" opacity="0.08"></rect>
          <line x1="20" y1="105" x2="740" y2="105" stroke="var(--baseline)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 5"></line>
          <text x="744" y="109" font-size="13" fill="var(--text-muted)">θ̂</text>
          <path d="M20,140 Q65,30 110,30 Q155,30 200,105 Q245,140 290,170 Q335,140 380,105 Q425,30 470,30 Q515,30 560,105 Q605,140 650,140" fill="none" stroke="var(--series-1)" stroke-width="2.5"></path>
          <g font-size="13" font-weight="700">
            <circle cx="110" cy="30" r="6" fill="var(--series-7)"></circle><text x="110" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--series-7)">τ1 peak</text>
            <circle cx="200" cy="105" r="6" fill="var(--series-1)"></circle><text x="200" y="128" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--series-1)">τ2 cross</text>
            <circle cx="290" cy="170" r="6" fill="var(--series-7)"></circle><text x="290" y="193" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--series-7)">τ3 trough</text>
            <circle cx="380" cy="105" r="6" fill="var(--series-1)"></circle><text x="380" y="92" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--series-1)">τ4 cross</text>
            <circle cx="470" cy="30" r="6" fill="var(--series-7)"></circle><text x="470" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--series-7)">τ5 peak</text>
            <circle cx="560" cy="105" r="6" fill="var(--series-1)"></circle><text x="560" y="128" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--series-1)">τ6 cross</text>
          </g>
          <g font-size="12" fill="var(--text-secondary)">
            <text x="155" y="60" text-anchor="middle">6 days</text>
            <text x="335" y="60" text-anchor="middle">4 days</text>
            <text x="515" y="60" text-anchor="middle">8 days</text>
          </g>
        </svg>
        <div class="cap">Shaded = stopwatch running (extreme → next mean crossing). A swing counts only if it moves ≥ C·s from the mean (C = 2, s = spread std dev). B is chosen to minimize this EMRT time.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pageno" data-n="">3 / 7</div>
  </section>

  <!-- P5: MDP -->
  <section class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Part 2 · Trading</div>
    <h1>Trading as an MDP: state, action, reward</h1>
    <h2>The agent trades the fixed spread X<sub>t</sub> = S<sub>1</sub> − B*S<sub>2</sub>, one unit at a time</h2>
    <div class="body">
      <div class="diagram-wrap">
        <div class="chip-row" style="justify-content:center;">
          <span style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-right:8px;">State S<sub>t</sub></span>
          <div class="chip" style="background:var(--series-1);"><span class="sym">↑</span><span class="val">+1</span></div>
          <div class="chip" style="background:var(--series-1);"><span class="sym">↑↑</span><span class="val">+2</span></div>
          <div class="chip" style="background:var(--series-2);"><span class="sym">↓</span><span class="val">−1</span></div>
          <div class="chip" style="background:var(--series-8);"><span class="sym">↓↓</span><span class="val">−2</span></div>
          <span class="chip-arrow">→</span>
          <div class="chip-box">S<sub>t</sub> = [+1, +2, −1, −2]</div>
        </div>
        <div class="cap">Last l = 4 daily % moves of the spread, each bucketed at k = 3% (small / big, up / down) → 4<sup>4</sup> = 256 states</div>
      </div>
      <div class="two-col" style="gap:24px;">
        <div class="card">
          <h3>Action</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>{sell −1, hold 0, buy +1}</li>
            <li>Flat → buy or hold; long → sell or hold; never short</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="eq" style="align-self:stretch; padding-top:26px;">
          R<sub>t+1</sub> = A<sub>t</sub>·(θ − X<sub>t</sub>) − c·|A<sub>t</sub>|
          <span class="caption">Paid for trading <b>toward</b> the mean: buy below θ, sell above θ. Uses today's gap, not tomorrow's move.</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <ul class="points">
        <li>The state carries <b>no level information</b> — only the shape of recent moves.</li>
        <li>The agent is a <b>price-taker</b>: its trades don't move the spread.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="pageno" data-n="">4 / 7</div>
  </section>

  <!-- P6: Q-learning -->
  <section class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Part 2 · Trading</div>
    <h1>Q-learning: from one-step rewards to a 256 × 3 table</h1>
    <h2>Each reward only looks at today; the future enters through the next state's Q-value</h2>
    <div class="body">
      <div class="flow">
        <div class="flow-step">
          <div class="num">One step</div>
          <h4>R<sub>t+1</sub></h4>
          <p>Reward for today's action</p>
        </div>
        <div class="flow-step">
          <div class="num">Discounted total</div>
          <h4>G<sub>t</sub> = Σ<sub>k</sub> γ<sup>k</sup> R<sub>t+k+1</sub></h4>
          <p>= R<sub>t+1</sub> + γG<sub>t+1</sub> &nbsp;(random)</p>
        </div>
        <div class="flow-step">
          <div class="num">Expected total</div>
          <h4>Q(s,a) = E[G<sub>t</sub> | s, a]</h4>
          <p>One fixed number per cell</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="eq">
        Q(S<sub>t</sub>,A<sub>t</sub>) ← Q(S<sub>t</sub>,A<sub>t</sub>) + α·[ R<sub>t+1</sub> + γ·max<sub>a</sub> Q(S<sub>t+1</sub>,a) − Q(S<sub>t</sub>,A<sub>t</sub>) ]
        <span class="caption">The bracketed target R + γ·max Q(S<sub>t+1</sub>) is a one-step stand-in for G<sub>t</sub> (bootstrapping). Q converges; it doesn't accumulate.</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-row">
        <div class="stat-tile"><div class="num">α = 0.1</div><div class="lbl">learning rate</div></div>
        <div class="stat-tile"><div class="num">γ = 0.99</div><div class="lbl">discount factor</div></div>
        <div class="stat-tile"><div class="num">ε = 0.1 → 0</div><div class="lbl">ε-greedy in training, greedy at test</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pageno" data-n="">5 / 7</div>
  </section>

  <!-- P7: simulation (optional) -->
  <section class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Part 2 · Aside</div>
    <h1>Why the agent trains on simulated spreads</h1>
    <h2>The reward needs something you never observe in real markets</h2>
    <div class="body">
      <div class="two-col">
        <div class="card baseline">
          <h3>Problem</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>The reward uses the <b>true</b> mean θ — unknown on real data</li>
            <li>One real price path is far too little data to fill 256 × 3 cells</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <h3>Fix</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Simulate 10,000 one-year OU paths with known θ (μ=1, θ=1, σ=0.1)</li>
            <li>Train the Q-table there, then trade the <b>real</b> 2023 spread with it</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <ul class="points">
        <li>All headline results that follow are on <b>real</b> stock data; only training is synthetic.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="pageno" data-n="">6 / 7</div>
  </section>

  <!-- P8: results -->
  <section class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Results</div>
    <h1>RL wins on daily Sharpe in every pair</h1>
    <h2>10 US sector pairs · B fit on 2022, traded in 2023 · daily closes from Yahoo Finance</h2>
    <div class="body">
      <div class="two-col" style="gap:28px; align-items:start;">
        <div>
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Table 3: performance summary, MSFT-GOOGL / CVS-JNJ / CL-KMB / V-MA / GE-BA" style="width:100%; display:block; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px;">
        </div>
        <div>
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Table 4: performance summary, OXY-XOM / WELL-VTR / PPG-SHW / VZ-TMUS / CSX-NSC" style="width:100%; display:block; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px;">
        </div>
      </div>
      <ul class="points" style="margin-top:18px;">
        <li><b>Benchmarks:</b> Distance Method (B=1, trade at ±1σ) and OU trading (OU-fit B, trade at ±0.5σ<sub>eq</sub>).</li>
        <li>Best daily Sharpe (DailySR) in <b>10 / 10</b> pairs. Mean daily Sharpe: DM <b>0.024</b>, OU <b>0.047</b>, RL <b>0.100</b>.</li>
        <li>Best or tied-best max drawdown in 9 / 10 pairs. Negative DailySR entries (e.g. V-MA, PPG-SHW under DM) are real — those benchmark strategies lost money on those pairs.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>

<div class="progress" id="progress" style="width: 0%;"></div>

<script>
  const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
  const total = slides.length;
  slides.forEach((sl, i) => { const el = sl.querySelector('[data-n]'); if (el) el.textContent = (i + 1) + ' / ' + total; });

  function updateProgress() {
    const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
    const docHeight = document.body.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
    const pct = docHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / docHeight) * 100 : 0;
    document.getElementById('progress').style.width = pct + '%';
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateProgress, { passive: true });
  updateProgress();

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (['ArrowRight', 'ArrowDown', 'PageDown', ' '].includes(e.key)) {
      window.scrollBy({ top: window.innerHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowUp', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
      window.scrollBy({ top: -window.innerHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (e.key === 'Home') { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); }
    if (e.key === 'End') { window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); }
  });

  function bar(container, rows, maxAbs) {
    const el = document.getElementById(container);
    el.innerHTML = '';
    rows.forEach(r => {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'bar-row';
      const pct = Math.max(2, Math.abs(r.v) / maxAbs * 100);
      const neg = r.v < 0;
      row.innerHTML =
        '<div class="label">' + r.l + '</div>' +
        '<div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:' + pct + '%; background:' + r.c + ';' + (neg ? 'margin-left:auto;' : '') + '"></div></div>' +
        '<div class="value">' + r.v.toFixed(3) + '</div>';
      el.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

</script>
<script>
      addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(()=>{
        document.body.setAttribute('data-layout-overflow',JSON.stringify(
          [...document.querySelectorAll('.slide')].map((s,i)=>({slide:i+1,
          excess:Math.max(0,s.scrollHeight-s.clientHeight)})).filter(x=>x.excess>2)));
      },100));
    </script>
